args.title: Brightline Freight: Retail returns logistics (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
- Reselling returned goods within 10 days preserved most of the margin.

Sources: Brightline Freight newsletter "Retail returns logistics"; article https://blog.brightline.example/2026/returns; companion piece https://insights.brightline.example/returns/companion
